'''Fush Budget All Round Dark Side''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fush]]
* '''Published:''' 18 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Docking Bay|Premiere-D-yavin4dockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yavin 4: Docking Bay
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Yavin 4 Docking Bay Fush DS 2002.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A "budget" all-round deck built in expensive Norway. (A reflections 3 booster is almost $10 here...) Please comment.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

I'm most likely not one of the heavy card-buyers around. I've tried to put toghether this "all round" deck based on the cards I've got. I would like to have some comments on it though. How far would it take me, and how much more do I need to invest in it to keep up? Which adjustments are desperatly needed? Living in Norway, I've not been to any tournaments yet...
